name: Fettuccine Alfredo with Ham, Bell Pepper, Zucchini & Parsley
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; add to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, small dice ham and add to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and ham; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are soft, add parsley, Alfredo sauce, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is warmed through, about 2 minutes.
Transfer drained pasta to the skillet and toss to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
